risk_free_source: Canada 3-month T-bill, Bank of Canada, Sep 2026
objective: maximize mu'w - (lambda/2) w'Sigma w, weights sum to 1, no shorting
min_weight_rule: funds under min_weight_per_fund are dropped and the problem is solved again at the same lambda (up to 3 rounds); the weights in risk_aversion are after this step
weights_note: the weights in risk_aversion are one estimate (resampling off); the product averages 200 resampled histories at the same lambda, so its weights differ by a few tenths of a point
level_rule: target volatility = level / 5 x volatility of the stock part of the policy prior
note: Lambda is calibrated on this shelf. On another shortlist the engine re-solves it to hit the same target volatility.
